limits: Fitted task loss comes only from independent standard-profile calibration catalogs.
Validation labels are diagnostic, never select hyperparameters or enter test schedulers.
Test rows, hidden modes, answers, full trajectories, and task outputs never enter scheduler.
Task outputs do not update belief; known symmetric hazards and perfect receipts remain assumptions.
Menus are paired on the same data/tasks/mode tape. All streams kept.
No new domain transfer: same R4 API extended with threshold contexts and data-shift stress.
Exact DP and reward-error bound are classical references, not a new theorem.
Sharing precompiled policies is explicit; compilation, training and execution separately timed.
User reproduction is the same frozen scientific batch, not new independent data.
